says: The runner makes the wake `Timer` with Schema `make` from a time that arrives over the object's `due` call or is read back from storage, with no decode.
proof: In: next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/runtime.ts:2651 `due: (at: number) => attributed(runner.due(at))` takes the time over RPC, and next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/runtime.ts:2663 reads the stored wake with `storage.get<number>("wake")`; neither decodes. Make: next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Runner.ts:2949 `Timer.make({ at: time, arrivedAt })`, whose `at` is `Schema.Number` (next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Runner.ts:457).
cost: A stored or sent wake that is not a number makes the timer letter throw a defect. Before #1619 the literal was sent as JSON and never checked at all, so the cost is small; the call still breaks decision 0215 for storage read back.
